request.name: Woodland Bar Rim
request.prompt: Create a production game UI texture, not a mockup. Match the supplied woodland ant RTS interface: dimensional warm dark bark, hand-carved irregular branches, ochre cut edges, tiny amber knots, a few olive leaves, restrained warm highlights. Chonky believable craftsmanship with readable clear silhouette; no wispy vines, no gold metal filigree. Straight-on screen view, no perspective. No text, portraits, icons, numbers or scenery. True alpha transparency, never a checkerboard painted into the image. ONLY a simple horizontal rectangular bark perimeter frame. Outer bounds 24,40 to1512,472. Branch rails around20 pixels thick, rectangular empty transparent interior, straight parallel top/bottom rails. Small faceted amber knot centered on each short end and restrained olive corner leaves. This border will be sliced to make long slender health/mana bars, resource strip and new-spell button: keep long rails simple repeatable straight bark; all decorations confined to corners and short ends. No content or black fill.
